notes: Recurring setup is part of payment.flow.ts (offer_recurring/confirm_recurring/setup_recurring steps). recurring-manage.flow.ts handles subscription management ('subscriptions' keyword).

subscriptionCreation.notes: Creates customer_subscriptions row after first payment + consent.

paystackRenewal.notes: Full Payment Authority lifecycle. apply_payment_spend_once fires in Stage 2.

flutterwaveRenewal.notes: Creates booking + payment in SQL RPC. Platform fee computed in SQL. Calls sendProactiveConfirmation (Stage 3 only). DOES NOT call processSuccessfulPayment (Stage 2).

stripeRenewal.authority: Stripe auto-charges via provider subscription. Webhook → reconcilePayment.

customerSpend.authority: apply_payment_spend_once for Paystack/Stripe (via Stage 2). MISSING for Flutterwave (#164).
customerSpend.notes: #164 regression: Flutterwave renewals skip Stage 2 entirely.

forbiddenWrites: customer_subscriptions.charge_count outside finalize_token_recurring_charge or Paystack/Stripe webhooks
customer_profiles.total_spent — use apply_payment_spend_once (not available for Flutterwave renewals currently)

sessionKeys.cleanup: Session deactivated by executor terminal step.
sessionKeys.notes: Recurring setup steps (offer_recurring, confirm_recurring, setup_recurring) live in payment.flow.ts. recurring-manage.flow.ts handles subscription management via 'subscriptions' keyword in a separate session.

knownDebt: #164 — Flutterwave recurring renewals skip Stage 2 (apply_payment_spend_once never called)
#165 — Recurring continuation after Stage 3 session deactivation is dead code
